# AMP Email Gallery

> Interactive field guide to AMP for Email on CleverTap. 72 template prototypes across
> 9 industry verticals with feasibility ratings and extractable AMP4Email production code.
> Maintained by SJ Neo, Enterprise Customer Success Manager, CleverTap APAC.

URL: https://shijunneo-bot.github.io/amp-email-gallery/

## Key facts

- AMP for Email lets recipients interact inside the inbox: forms, carousels, live data.
- CleverTap documents AMP support through SendGrid. Other sending routes fall back to HTML.
- AMP requires the Email Booster Max or Advanced Email add-on on the CleverTap plan.
- Rendering clients listed in CleverTap documentation: Gmail, Yahoo Mail, Mail.ru, FairEmail.
- AMP content expires 30 days after receipt. Forwarded messages show the HTML fallback.
- Form submissions route through `@SpecialLinks - Submit Form` and land as a CleverTap event.
- Every AMP email needs an HTML fallback for clients that do not render AMP.

## Sections

- AMP Gallery: 72 prototypes with Green, Amber and Red feasibility ratings.
  Green works with standard AMP components. Amber needs backend infrastructure.
  Red is conceptual, with suggested workarounds.
- Award Journeys: DBS journey builder walkthrough.
- Partner Stack: the five partner layers an email passes through.
  Design (Stripo, Alpaco, Email Love, Taxi for Email),
  Validate (Clearout, Kickbox),
  Enrich (Movable Ink, NiftyImages, Sendtric, Litmus, Mailmodo and others),
  Localise (Crowdin, Lokalise),
  Deliver (SendGrid, Amazon SES, Postmark, Mandrill, Gmail, Generic SMTP).
  The delivery layer is what determines whether AMP renders.
